## Description

Please include a summary of the changes and related context.

## Type of Change

- [ ] New feature ([FEAT])
- [ ] Bug fix ([FIX])
- [ ] Performance improvement ([PERF])
- [ ] Refactoring ([REFACTOR])
- [ ] Documentation ([DOCS])
- [ ] Testing ([TEST])
- [ ] Code style ([STYLE])
- [ ] Other ([CLEAN])

## Related Issue

Fixes #(issue number)

## Checklist

- [ ] I have followed the development standards in [DEVELOPMENT_STANDARDS.md](../DEVELOPMENT_STANDARDS.md)
- [ ] I have updated documentation as necessary
- [ ] I have added tests for new functionality
- [ ] My code follows the project's naming conventions
- [ ] I have reviewed my own code before submitting
- [ ] My commit messages follow the format: `[CATEGORY] Description`

## Code Quality

- [ ] No hardcoded values
- [ ] Functions are under 50 lines (ideal)
- [ ] Proper error handling implemented
- [ ] No memory leaks or resource issues
- [ ] Performance considered

## Testing

- [ ] Unit tests added/updated
- [ ] Manual testing completed
- [ ] Edge cases considered
- [ ] No breaking changes
